body:
Phase 4 (plan §8, marketplace listing): the herdr plugin lives at `plugins/adlc-herdr/` in this monorepo, but herdr's marketplace lists public repos that carry the `herdr-plugin` GitHub TOPIC and indexes them at their ROOT (re-scanning the default branch ~every 30 min; `herdr plugin install voodootikigod/adlc-herdr` installs from that branch — no git version tags are involved). So the plugin is published through a flattened, read-only MIRROR repo (voodootikigod/adlc-herdr) that is kept in lockstep with the monorepo by CI.

WHAT TO BUILD

1. A pure, tested transform `scripts/sync-herdr-mirror.mjs` that mirrors `plugins/adlc-herdr/**` into a target directory flattened to its root: clear the target (preserving only `.git`), copy the plugin tree, carry the monorepo LICENSE over, and rewrite the README (prepend a read-only-mirror banner; rewrite monorepo-relative links that escape the plugin dir — inline `](../x)` and reference-style `[label]: ../x` — to absolute blob URLs so they do not 404 at the mirror root). Git operations are the caller's job.

2. A GitHub Actions workflow `.github/workflows/sync-herdr-mirror.yml` that fires only on a push to main touching the plugin, the LICENSE, the sync script, or the workflow itself: it checks out the monorepo and the mirror (the mirror with write access via a deploy key held in the secret HERDR_MIRROR_DEPLOY_KEY), runs the sync script, and commits+pushes to the mirror if anything changed. The workflow's own GITHUB_TOKEN stays read-only; actions are SHA-pinned.

SECURITY: the sync runs in CI with a cross-repo write credential, and the plugin tree is treated as potentially-tampered input. The transform (a) fails CLOSED on a target that IS, contains, or sits inside the source repo (canonicalized with realpathSync so a case-insensitive filesystem or a symlinked target cannot bypass it) so it can never wipe the source; (b) strips any `.github/` from the mirror so a plugin-side workflow can never run in the mirror's Actions context; (c) fails CLOSED on any symlink in the copied tree so the README write cannot be redirected through a link to a runner file; and (d) fails CLOSED (does not auto-wipe the published mirror) if the plugin dir is missing.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (each with a concrete verification method)

AC1 flatten + LICENSE + README transform: syncMirror copies the plugin to the target root (bin/ and lib/ stay siblings), adds the LICENSE, and prepends the banner. VERIFY: unit test in scripts/test/sync-herdr-mirror.test.mjs.
AC2 stale-file removal + .git preservation: a file deleted from the plugin is removed from the mirror on the next sync, but the mirror's `.git` is preserved. VERIFY: unit test.
AC3 link rewriting: inline and reference-style monorepo-relative links that escape the plugin dir become absolute blob URLs; already-absolute and in-repo (`./x`) links are untouched. VERIFY: unit tests over transformReadme.
AC4 no overlap wipe: a target that is, contains, is contained by, or is a symlink to the source repo is REFUSED (never wiped), even when the source is itself a git checkout. VERIFY: unit tests with equality, containment, and symlinked targets.
AC5 no .github propagation: a `.github/workflows/*.yml` under the plugin dir never reaches the mirror. VERIFY: unit test asserting the mirror has no `.github`.
AC6 no symlink write-through: a README committed as a symlink to an outside file causes syncMirror to fail closed, and the linked file is not written through. VERIFY: unit test asserting the throw and the untouched target file.
AC7 missing plugin fails closed: a missing plugin dir throws (the mirror is not auto-wiped). VERIFY: unit test.
AC8 no hollow tests: the mutation-gate finds all mutants in scripts/sync-herdr-mirror.mjs killed. VERIFY: preflight mutation-gate.
AC9 trust-root prosecution: because the change touches `.github/workflows/**` (a rails deny-path), a distinct-provider cross-model adversarial approve is recorded for the reviewed revision. VERIFY: adlc-prosecute tier-check + the recorded cross-model attestation in the manifest.
title: herdr plugin: marketplace mirror auto-sync
